acceptanceCriteria: Go directive text inside string literals, block comments and ordinary explanatory comments does not suppress pinned caller evidence.
Only recognized trailing GOOS/GOARCH filename suffixes, before optional _test, withhold Go sources; platform words in interior positions do not.
Retain red/green full Compile regression fixtures, actual constraint controls, focused package tests and vet, independent review, dogfood evidence and a ready PR.
body:
Confirmed on origin/main 9afd8313edad658d6c40b1abe454fe7417eb6cad, Core source version 1.0.0-rc.1. buildConditional uses whole-byte substring checks and every underscore-separated filename component. Four committed two-repository Compile regressions fail: //go:build and // +build in string literals, api_linux_helpers.go/caller_linux_helpers.go, and api_amd64_helpers.go/caller_amd64_helpers_test.go. Expected pinned caller edges; actual empty edges plus API build constraints unresolved. Red reproduction: /private/tmp/corvint-bug-hunt-evidence/red.log. This is a source candidate finding, not a claim about qualification of installed Core build 163.

Reviewed repair published ready for review: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/415, branch codex/bug-hunt-0930 in /private/tmp/corvint-bug-hunt-0930. Final bind 2508765e6e41f94cbd1e2a0b9675e10d19df9b4c; seal HEAD 3367ef0dbf0273047e62cfe7d56f37660f0f720c is exactly one R100 CEM rename. Exact-target frozen package (26.003s), vet and focused docs passed; CLI and spec-index checks passed on unchanged production/spec inputs before mechanical test-label edits. Independent source review found a header-placement issue, red reproduction and repair passed re-review. Independent CEM verification canonical/ready-for-ci: 10 supported, 0 unknown; OCM BKM-V0-004 linked to six code/test hunks and five keyed case-name claims, seven other obligations unassessed, map testExecution NOT_RUN. Enrolled workflow satisfied and make dogfood-check / dogfood-seal PASS. Focused/raw receipts, reports, checks and checkpoint: /private/tmp/corvint-bug-hunt-evidence/. Full repository/release gates NOT_RUN under scoped-work policy. Native claim refused RESOURCE_COLLISION (another attempt owns shared CEM paths); no reservation was bypassed and no submit/gate/complete was substituted. Ticket remains OPEN pending integration/landing and native completion. No merge, force-push, deletion or release performed. Selector-discovery friction deduplicated and retained on V1-0275.
